presets.title: World Presets
presets.balanceDesc: All 15+ simulation mechanics active in living harmony: balanced border skirmishes, mild predation, seasonal plagues, bridges, and thriving multi-generational clans.
presets.sustainableDesc: Bountiful agriculture (360 food), rich granaries, seasonal banquets, glowing temples, and gentle winters for long flourishing dynasties.
presets.theocracyDesc: Spiritual civilization: devoted prayer to the 8 Sacred 2D Avatars, glowing Temples of the Sphere, divine miracles, and holy synods.
presets.warlordsDesc: High martial expansion: tactical clan warfare, defensive coalitions, granary plundering, territorial takeovers, and contested thrones.
presets.chaosDesc: Brutal stress test: high predator packs, lethal wars, frequent plagues, wildfires, earthquakes, and rapid seasonal turnover.
presets.extinctionDesc: Extreme famine (120 food), freezing winter (0.3x), rampant disease, exposure drain, and desperate cannibalism.
presets.boomDesc: Massive urban growth: rapid reproduction, food abundance (500), giant granaries, bridges, and bustling settlements.

wiki.title: 📖 Flatland Wiki
wiki.aboutDesc: Flatland is an autonomous 2D artificial life and ecosystem simulation developed from the foundational ideas of Edwin A. Abbott's 1884 classic Flatland: A Romance of Many Dimensions. Rather than mimicking the novella literally, it takes Flatland's core geometric premises to build a living, autonomous evolutionary ecosystem that organically evolves and changes over time.
wiki.sphereDesc: The Sphere (God Model): The Sphere (God) sets universal laws of nature from Spaceland, never intervening in individual lives. Everything is 100% emergent.
wiki.evolutionDesc: Autonomous Evolution: Heritable personality archetypes (brave, altruistic, builder, etc.), tools (spears, baskets, poultices, crowns), 4 mastery skills (Farming 🌾, Combat ⚔️, Foraging 🦴, Healing 🌿), dynamic titles, and oral lore taught in houses.
wiki.lifeStagesDesc: Life Stages & Metabolism: Infant low burn (0.45×), combat stamina drain, field food reserves, and natural lifespans.
wiki.settlementsDesc: Settlements & Politics: Walled houses, multi-house clan territories, settlement food larders, mutual coalitions, and schisms.
wiki.spherePanelDesc: The Sphere Panel (⚖ The Sphere) — Adjust carrying capacity, food growth, metabolism, disease, and apply presets.
wiki.inspectorDesc: Creature Inspector — Tap any creature to view its live vitals, personality, tools, skill mastery, and family lineage.
wiki.controlsDesc: Controls: Space pause, S step, R reset seed, F fit camera, +/- zoom, drag to pan.
wiki.docWiki: Backend Living Wiki (/wiki) — Full documentation with presets & curl playground
wiki.docGuide: Living Guide (/guide) — Codebase architecture and system maps
wiki.bookTitle: 📚 Flatland: Abbott's Novella vs. The Simulation
wiki.bookDesc: A comparative study between Edwin A. Abbott’s 1884 satirical classic Flatland: A Romance of Many Dimensions and our autonomous artificial life simulation.
wiki.hierarchyBook: "Configuration makes the man." Social rank is governed strictly by side count and angular regularity.
wiki.hierarchySim: Entities inherit exact geometric castes based on vertex count (N-gons) and regularity.
wiki.womenBook: Straight lines (zero angular width). Required to maintain a continuous peace-cry to prevent accidental stabbing.
wiki.womenSim: Rendered as 1D segments (shape: 'line'). Highly agile with distinct domestic shelter dynamics.
wiki.soldiersBook: Isosceles triangles with sharp vertex angles (volatile and militaristic).
wiki.soldiersSim: Soldiers: High combat damage, defensive patrolling, equipped with spears.
wiki.artisansBook: Equilateral triangles (3 equal sides) — steady tradespeople.
wiki.artisansSim: Artisans (3–4 sides): Farmers, foragers, and builders managing houses and larders.
wiki.gentlemenBook: Squares (4 sides), Pentagons (5 sides), Hexagons (6 sides), and high polygons.
wiki.gentlemenSim: Gentlemen (4), Professionals (5), Nobles (6–8): Administrative prestige and leadership.
wiki.priestsBook: Polygons with so many sides that vertices appear as smooth circles. Rule society and religion.
wiki.priestsSim: Priests (≥ 24 sides): Soothing auras, healing injured/infected clanmates, disease immunity.
wiki.bookSection2Desc: In Abbott's world, the Law of Upward Development guarantees that sons of regular polygons gain +1 side over their fathers (Square → Pentagon → Hexagon), ascending toward circular priesthood over generations. In our simulation, offspring inherit side counts with probabilistic side promotions (sides += 1) and lineage tracking via the Family Tree.
wiki.bookSection3Desc: In Flatland, 2D beings look like flat edges. In the foggy South, they rely on Sight Recognition (how quickly vertices fade into fog). In our simulation, the Dynamic Weather Engine simulates Clear, Fog, Rain, and Storms, modulating creature sight_radius and forcing reliance on auditory alarms (signals).
wiki.bookSection4: 4. The Higher Dimension: The User as "The Sphere"
wiki.bookSection4Desc: In the novel, A Square is visited by A Sphere from 3D Spaceland, who gazes down into closed rooms, inspects interiors, and manipulates 2D physics. In our app, you are the Sphere (God): peering down from the Z-axis, inspecting creature minds and lineage, and tuning the fundamental Laws of Nature via The Sphere Panel.
wiki.lawsNote: Type/range/default + hint from docs/god-laws.md. Edit in The Sphere panel or POST /api/laws.
wiki.footerLive: Wiki is live — {{laws}} laws · {{routes}} routes · {{presets}} presets
wiki.inspiration: Built with OpenCode & Antigravity · Inspired by Edwin A. Abbott's Flatland

godHints.food_count: the world keeps this much food alive — bounty or famine (winter ×0.5, summer ×1.2)
godHints.plant_growth_rate: how fast plants mature (0.05) — berry 0.65×, mushroom 0.85×, poison 0.6×, season multiplies
godHints.plant_spread_rate: chance a mature plant seeds a nearby sprout each tick
godHints.nutrient_cycle_rate: corpse decay boost to nearby plants (0.65) — death feeds life
godHints.poison_rate: chance a new sprout is poisonous (0.01) — 1% sicken, berry heals +1, poison -30 health
godHints.beast_ratio: wild herbivores as fraction of creature density — grazers that feed predators
godHints.diet_strictness: 0 omnivore, 1 strict — herbivore ignores meat, predator ignores plants
godHints.territory_radius: clan territory circle radius around house (14) — members steer home, trespass sours relations
godHints.trespass_decay: relation points lost per tick a rival trespasses inside territory
godHints.house_decay_ticks: abandoned house ticks before crumbling to ruin (2400 = 2 seasons)
godHints.energy_decay_per_tick: how fast all life burns without eating (0.025) — winter/rain adds 0.03 exposure if roofless
godHints.energy_from_food: base energy from a mature plant (32) — berry 48, mushroom 24, grass 32, poison 8
godHints.perceive_radius: base sight (20) — each caste scales it (Woman 0.8×, Priest 1.35×), night 0.6×, fog 0.6×, Eye totem 1.25×
godHints.food_giveup_ticks: a meal blocked by rock/wall is abandoned this many ticks — the hungry give up and seek food elsewhere (0 = never give up)
godHints.door_clearance: doorways scale with the largest creature × this (1.5)
godHints.house_min_size: applies to houses built after the next reset (6)
godHints.house_max_size: applies to houses built after the next reset (10)
godHints.adult_age: creatures must be this many ticks old to mate (200)
godHints.birth_rate: chance per eligible pair per tick, before fertility (0.35)
godHints.sex_ratio: probability a child is a son (polygons ascend; daughters are lines)
godHints.mutation_rate: chance a son’s side count deviates ±1 from inheritance (0.05)
godHints.euthanasia_threshold: irregular children at/above this are consumed at adulthood, below it demoted (0.7)
godHints.carrying_capacity: above this population, fertility fades gradually (-1 = scale with map area, 80 per 200×200)
godHints.max_population: hard cap — no births beyond (-1 = scale with map area, 140 per 200×200)
godHints.house_capacity: beds in an 8×8 hall (12) — scales with floor area, so a small hut cannot hold a whole clan; overflow spills to the nearest roof with space
godHints.exposure_drain: energy lost per tick outdoors in rain/storm/night (0.03)
godHints.rest_recovery_mult: health regen multiplier when sleeping indoors (2.0)
godHints.age_length: ticks per age (12000 = 5 seasons) — Golden×1.25 food, Ice×0.55 food + chill, Chaos×1.8 mutation, Plague×1.8 disease
godHints.culture_spread_rate: allied clans within territory adopt same culture with this chance/tick (0.005)
godHints.trait_mutation_rate: chance mutation adds heritable trait greedy/peaceful/paranoid/bold (0.02) — bold war, paranoid flee, greedy food
godHints.fire_rate: chance a random mature plant ignites each tick (0.0005) — storm lightning raises to 0.002
godHints.river_count: channel bands across the map at world creation (2) — fords, floods, bridges & dams
godHints.signal_speed: news wavefront speed in units/tick (8) — distant ears hear the alarm later; wind carries sound faster downwind; 0 = instant
godHints.lightning_strike_rate: chance/tick of a bolt during a storm (0.0015)
godHints.anomaly_count: hidden zones of altered physics at world creation (3)
godHints.fire_spread_rate: spread to neighboring plants within 6 (0.08) — kills creatures/plants, ash fertilizes
godHints.disaster_rate: meteor/flood stochastic gated by this per tick (0.0003) — crater/water reshapes terrain
godHints.signal_radius: heard within this range (12) — clan-mates respond strongly, strangers weakly
godHints.food_call_rate: well-fed finds food → calls with this chance/tick (0.08)
godHints.knowledge_ttl: ticks a learned fact stays in memory before it fades (600)
godHints.knowledge_share_rate: chance/tick a creature broadcasts its freshest fact to clan-mates (0.05) — rumors arrive at half confidence
godHints.help_radius: clan-mates rally to a help call within this range (12); defenders near the fight soften its blows
godHints.defense_weight: damage reduction per defender mobbing the attacker (0.5 → 2 defenders = 50% softer)
godHints.winter_food_mult: winter bounty × winter_food_mult (0.7 gentle, 0.5 harsh, 0.3 extinction) — lean season target = food_count × winter_food_mult
godHints.schism_min_pop: minimum clan population to consider schism (4)
godHints.coalition_threshold: relation score at which a leader may fold another clan into a coalition (40)
godHints.coalition_min_size: smallest viable coalition; smaller blocs dissolve (2)
godHints.larder_capacity: energy a clan store at the settlement can hold (300) — surplus deposited, famine withdraws
godHints.aid_rate: chance/tick a full-bellied ally tops up a starving ally's larder (0.05)

godToggles.birth_enabledHint: whether new life may begin at all — off hides the lineage dials
godToggles.disease_enabledHint: plagues walk the world; disabling freezes all sickness
godToggles.weather_enabledHint: whether the weather ever turns — off hides rain/fog/storm dials everywhere
godToggles.sleep_enabledHint: creatures shelter in houses after dark
godToggles.shelter_enabledHint: creatures may claim roofs; disabling leaves all exposed and hides the shelter dials
godToggles.hearths_enabledHint: kin buy hearth fuel from the larder — a lit hearth warms the roof through winter; unfed, it goes dark
godToggles.territory_enabledHint: clans claim a circle around their house; disabling removes borders
godToggles.weather_sickness_enabledHint: chill and wet contagion — rain/storm/winter nights build chill, past threshold drains health; wet catches disease faster
godToggles.communication_enabledHint: food + alarm calls — clan-mates respond strongly, strangers weakly; rendered as ripples
godToggles.knowledge_enabledHint: creatures learn facts from experience (food/danger/enemies/safe homes), share them as rumors at half confidence; the clan remembers
godToggles.help_call_enabledHint: an attacked creature calls its clan; warriors rally first and mob the attacker, defenders soften its blows
godToggles.wildfire_enabledHint: fire ignites via storm lightning / fire_rate and spreads grass→plant→house; ash fertilizes
godToggles.disaster_enabledHint: meteor/flood stochastic — god sets frequency, never a specific strike
godToggles.rivers_enabledHint: horizontal channels: fords cost energy, the current sweeps infants and the wounded, rain floods the banks and leaves silt; builders span planks and raise dams
godToggles.relief_enabledHint: the land has height: uphill burns energy, cliffs deal fall damage, rain slides steep slopes, feet pack fast roads that grow nothing
godToggles.earthquake_enabledHint: rare quakes throw bodies, drop weakened roofs and crack stone; Pentagons+ feel the deep hum three ticks early
godToggles.lightning_enabledHint: bolts kill under the arc, ignite the ground and fuse electrostatic rock
godToggles.structural_enabledHint: storms & floodwater wear buildings down; builders mend what still stands; a spent roof collapses to ruin
godToggles.rubble_blocking_enabledHint: collapsed ruins leave rubble that bars the ground until builders clear it
godToggles.culture_enabledHint: culture spreads to allied neighbours, can split into rival traditions; grants small collective bonus
godToggles.age_enabledHint: super-seasons: Golden/Ice/Chaos/Plague — each bends food/mutation/disease/chill. God sets length, world cycles
godToggles.schism_enabledHint: unhappy members (starving/homeless) split off to found new clan then war parent — schism_threshold fraction to trigger
godToggles.totems_enabledHint: each clan bears one of the 8 Sacred Avatars of the Sphere (⭕ ⚡ 👁️ 🛡️ 🌿 ⚖️ 🌀 🕯️) granting a distinct divine blessing; disabling makes all clans plain
godToggles.succession_enabledHint: leader succession on death emits succession event; disabling keeps founder as eternal leader
godToggles.plant_variants_enabledHint: grass/berry/mushroom/poisonous diversity; disabling makes all plants grass
godToggles.predation_enabledHint: predators hunt prey; disabling makes them docile
godToggles.war_enabledHint: rival clans fight on contact; disabling enforces peace
godToggles.coalitions_enabledHint: allied clans form defensive blocs — strike one member and every mate turns on you; soured relations dissolve the pact
godToggles.leader_decisions_enabledHint: leaders declare war on remembered enemies, sue for peace when weakened, demand tribute, betray allies (bold→war, peaceful→peace, paranoid→betrayal)
godToggles.resource_sharing_enabledHint: a food store at the settlement: well-fed members deposit surplus, starving members withdraw; allies aid each other in famine
godToggles.tribute_enabledHint: weak clans pay periodic tribute from their larder to a stronger protector
godToggles.betrayal_enabledHint: a leader breaks an alliance and strikes — the betrayed clan's rivals are told the same tale (treason)
godToggles.defection_enabledHint: unhappy members (starving/homeless) walk to a healthier nearby banner, even a rival's
godToggles.cannibalism_enabledHint: the starving may hunt and eat living creatures — sated/hungry never do; cooldown between kills
godToggles.eat_enemy_enabledHint: enemy-clan members (negative relation) and the weak (starving/elder/wounded) of any clan are legitimate prey; never predators, infants or indoor refugees
godToggles.eat_kin_enabledHint: weak kin may be eaten too — at a terrible price: exile, stigma, and a clan that now counts you an enemy
godToggles.exile_on_kin_eatHint: the kin-eater is cast out and founds a one-being outcast band; disabling keeps them in the clan but shunned
godToggles.food_decay_enabledHint: mature plants wither after their lifespan (× variant pace), fertilise nearby soil, then vanish — nothing lasts forever
godToggles.theology_enabledHint: shrines beside main houses, dawn & dusk tithes fill the clan faith pool, the aura mends the faithful, seasonal miracles, law-change chimes & sermons, holy synods in crisis ages, temples at high faith
godToggles.agriculture_enabledHint: seed pouches from wild harvests, cultivated farm plots near the settlement (2× growth, 2.5× yield), weeding & tending, irrigation furrows by fertile groves
godToggles.granaries_enabledHint: a dry roofed store: sated harvesters lay grain & cured berries by (35%), starving members withdraw, feasts burn it
godToggles.soil_depletion_enabledHint: monocropping exhausts the soil grid and slows regrowth; corpses, withered plants and farmer compost restore it
godToggles.banquets_enabledHint: granary ≥80% feeds a feast: energy, cheer, warmer relations and +30% fertility while it lasts
godToggles.vocalizations_enabledHint: priest liturgy calms panic, women's peace-hum parts crowds, soldiers' war-chirps rally allies, artisan chimes gift basket food, touching vertices builds trust
godToggles.scent_enabledHint: foragers drop breadcrumb trails home from rich finds; violent deaths and ruins leave danger scent the young learn to avoid
godToggles.envoys_enabledHint: peaceful leaders send banner-carrying emissaries to rival houses; clans raise boundary stones that ring warning chimes at trespassers
godToggles.markets_enabledHint: allied neighbours found neutral trading posts at shared borders and barter surplus; peddler caravans carry goods and news between distant settlements
godToggles.omens_enabledHint: at each season turn a shrine priest proclaims what comes; worshippers who hear it head home prepared
godToggles.dialect_drift_enabledHint: isolated clans drift apart in speech; strangers understand each other less the further dialects split, allies converge on a shared tongue
godToggles.cosmologyNote: Hidden zones of altered physics — fertile ground, heavy gravity, calm air. Skilled foragers discover them; shrines beside one draw extra power. Law changes sweep a shimmer wave across the land.
godToggles.worshipNote: the Sacred Avatars of the Sphere: settled clans consecrate shrines, the devout tithe at dawn & dusk, faith works miracles, chimes ring when laws change, and high faith raises temples
godToggles.edgeHint: what happens at the edge of the world
